name: heart-to-heart
description: 心里有你：适合情侣与多人夜谈的离线真心话应用。

scripts.desktop:dist: npm run web:build && npm run mac:icon && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.android:sync: npm run web:build && cap sync android && npm run native:icons
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.ios:sync: npm run web:build && cap sync ios && npm run native:icons
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && cap open ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator build
scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check scripts/build-web.mjs
